text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So the reason the leaves withered
was over-fertilization...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's called fertilizer burn; when you use too much fertilizer, it can actually damage the plants.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry...
I just wanted them to grow up healthier...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, with proper treatment you'll recover.
Just be careful next time."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, we too must be careful
not to take in too much fertilizer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you let your guard down, it shows on the scale immediately.
I've seen countless students frantically running laps just to cut weight.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: T-That might indeed be the case...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Maybe I ate a few too many snacks, too...)
From that day on, Nishino Flower started practicing moderation and successfully managed her diet.
